hardware: Mac Studio M3 Ultra 96GB (same-hardware C_T and C_D)
dlp_proxy: local Ollama content classifier, num_predict=5, temperature=0, short email body
caveats: Ratio is for an LLM-based DLP inspector. A regex/keyword DLP would be far cheaper (smaller ratio); an API-hosted DLP adds network latency (larger effective C_D). Feature extraction is pure-Python CPU, hardware-insensitive at microsecond scale. num_predict capped at 5 tokens is a lower bound on C_D (full DLP verdicts may generate more).
